§3§lTHREE RECIPES IN THIS MOD CARE WHAT GRADE YOUR WATER IS - THE THREE THAT MAKE AN OXIDE.§r
In every one of them the water is not a coolant and not a solvent. It is §6literally the reagent§r: whatever it leaves behind ends up in the fired ceramic, which is why the grade lands on these three steps and on nothing else in the mod.

§e§lF-12 RECONVERSION§r §8- Chemical Plant t3, IV, 30s - the URANIUM grade§r
  §21,000 L Enriched UF6 + 2,000 L Hydrogen + 2,000 L of ONE WATER RUNG + circuit 1  ->  N x Ceramic UO2 Powder + 4,000 L HF back§r
  §8UF6 + 2 H2O + H2 -> UO2 + 4 HF. Base 4 at Grade 1.§r

§e§lF-20 TAILS RECONVERSION§r §8- Chemical Plant t3, IV, 18s - the MOX diluent§r
  §22,000 L Depleted UF6 + 4,000 L Hydrogen + 4,000 L of ONE WATER RUNG + circuit 1  ->  N x Depleted UO2 Powder§r
  §8The same reaction on the cascade tails, and the dirty route: no HF comes back. Base 8 at Grade 1.§r

§e§lF-21a THORIA§r §8- Chemical Dehydrator, IV, 25s - the THORIUM grade§r
  §28x Thorium Oxalate Dust + circuit 1 + 2,000 L of ONE WATER RUNG  ->  N x Thorium Dioxide Powder + 2,000 L Carbon Dioxide§r
  §8The oxalate cake is WASHED before it is fired - which is exactly what the real process does. Base 6 at Grade 1.§r

§e§lTHE LADDER§r §8- twenty-seven recipes, nine rungs on each of the three§r
  §8rung                  yield    F-12   F-20   F-21a§r
  §8Distilled Water       x0.5§r    §22§r      §24§r      §23§r     §8~32 Uraninite a rod§r
  §8Grade 1 Purified      x1.0§r    §24§r      §28§r      §26§r     §816.0 Uraninite a rod§r
  §8Grade 2               x1.5§r    §26§r     §212§r      §29§r
  §8Grade 3               x2.0§r    §28§r     §216§r     §212§r
  §8Grade 4               x2.5§r   §210§r     §220§r     §215§r     §8~6.4 - the retired chain's cost§r
  §8Grade 5               x3.0§r   §212§r     §224§r     §218§r
  §8Grade 6               x3.5§r   §214§r     §228§r     §221§r
  §8Grade 7               x4.0§r   §216§r     §232§r     §224§r
  §bGrade 8 Purified      x4.5§r   §218§r     §236§r     §227§r     §b3.6 Uraninite a rod§r

§6Grade 1 is the IDENTITY rung, so nothing you already build got dearer.§r §8F-20 gives 8 powder per 2,000 L of tails in 18 s where it used to give 20 per 5,000 L in 45 s - identical per litre and per second - and F-21a still gives its 6 per 8 oxalate. The ladder is new; the Grade 1 economics are not.§r

§e§lWHY ALL THREE, AND NOT JUST F-12§r
Because a ladder that only touches uranium is a ladder that §cinverts the balance rule on two of the four fuel grades§r. MOX is 30 parts F-20 powder to 2 parts plutonium dioxide, and thorium fuel is 30 parts F-21a thoria to 2 parts F-12 ceramic. With plain water on those two steps, the water ladder was worth §8x1.00§r to a MOX line and §8x1.12§r to a thorium line - against the §8x1.40§r the same water pays on the reactor. The bonus for POWER was bigger than the bonus for FUEL, which is precisely backwards. Graded, the four fuel grades feel §2x9.00, x7.15, x9.00 and x2.83§r, and every one of them is comfortably larger than x1.40 again.

§e§lWHAT THAT IS WORTH§r
One §bExtraction Derrick§r digs 6 Uraninite every 200 ticks - 36 a minute, §b3,240 over a 90-minute decay cycle§r. A full tier-5 silo burns §b201 rods§r in that time, and 3,240 / 16.0 is 202.5.
§6At Grade 1, one Derrick exactly feeds a fully built tier-5 plant.§r At Grade 4 you are back to what the retired four-step chain cost. At Grade 8 you are well past it.

§e§lAND A SECOND, MUCH SMALLER EFFECT§r
Purified water in the §breactor's feedwater hatch§r also multiplies the plant's EU: §2+5% a grade, x1.05 at Grade 1 up to x1.40 at Grade 8§r. The panel says so, in the STEAM CHAIN group:
  §9Feedwater: Grade 8 Purified Water - output x1.40§r
  §8(plain and distilled water run this plant at x1.00 - the grade is a bonus, never a requirement)§r

[warn]§cIt has to be a DEDICATED feedwater line.§r The reactor draws its feedwater §bworst-first§r, so a hatch row holding plain water and Grade 8 spends the plain water and pays you nothing. The fuel line does the exact opposite - F-12 matches the BEST rung you have piped to it.[/warn]

[note]§6Plain water is still enough, permanently.§r Plain and distilled both count as x1.00 on the reactor, so a plant that never sees a Purification Plant derives the same EU it derived before this release - to the last digit. No line appears on the panel below Grade 1.[/note]

[note]§6Distilled water is a real rung of the FUEL ladder, not an omission.§r It yields half of Grade 1 on all three steps, and §bevery other step in the chain is grade-blind§r - the press, the sinter, the lathe, the Hall and the Assembly Line neither know nor care. So without a Purification Plant you still reach all four fuel grades, at half rate. There is no second gate.[/note]

[warn]§cThe Spiral's coolant hatches are NOT feedwater.§r Grade 8 water is a perfectly good coolant and you may run it there - but the output multiplier is read from the feedwater hatches alone, and coolant will never pay it.[/warn]

[note]A water ladder is a route to §bcheaper fuel§r, never to more power. The whole ladder is worth +40% EU; moving one rung up the FUEL ladder - Uranium to MOX - is worth +100%.[/note]
